author: Inside Edition
description: Marion Karawia from California raises awareness for Marcus Gunn syndrome while also advocating for people who get bullied for their physical appearance. She was always aware that she was different from her peers growing up, and later in life learned more about the condition she had. She now uses her social media to educate and teach others to be confident in themselves. She shared her story with Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindall.
title: Creator With Marcus Gunn Embraces Her Differences, Empowering Others

author: Inside Edition
description: "Grey's Anatomy" star Eric Dane has died after battling ALS. Dane left a heartfelt message to his daughter and asked for it not to be released until the day of his death. Posted posthumously on Netflix on Friday, Dane speaks with Brad Falchuk about his condition. For the last year, the 53-year-old actor battled ALS, the progressive disease, known as Lou Gehrig's Disease. Dane worked to raise awareness and money for ALS research.
title: Eric Dane's Last Interview Released After His Death
